import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3')
scores = json.loads((root / 'scores-v1.json').read_text())
methods = ['parent'] + [f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000'
                        for arm in ['legacy-control', 'fine-mesh']
                        for endpoint in ['raw', 'EMA']]
metrics = {
    'mesh': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'template_gain', 'blank_error_RMS_DN16',
             'blank_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'blank_DC_RMS_DN16', 'blank_added_RMS_DN16'],
    'photo': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'crop_relative_band_error',
              'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'],
    'flat': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'block32_RMS_DN16',
             'crop_block32_RMS_DN16', 'worst_abs_DC_DN16'],
    'mixed-quiet': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_error_RMS_DN16',
                    'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_DC_RMS_DN16'],
}
groups = list(dict.fromkeys((s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) for s in scores['summary']))
result = []
for kind, condition, cohort in groups:
    if kind == 'real':
        continue
    rows = {s['method']: s for s in scores['summary']
            if (s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) == (kind, condition, cohort)}
    print(f'\n{kind} / {condition} / {cohort}; {rows["parent"]["cases"]} cases')
    for metric in metrics[kind]:
        if metric not in rows['parent']:
            continue
        values = {method: rows[method][metric] for method in methods}
        parent = values['parent']
        deltas = {method: (100 * (value / parent - 1) if parent else None)
                  for method, value in values.items()}
        print(metric, ' | '.join(f'{value:.8g}' for value in values.values()))
        print('  % vs V143', ' | '.join('n/a' if v is None else f'{v:+.5g}' for v in deltas.values()))
        result.append({'kind': kind, 'condition': condition, 'cohort': cohort,
                       'field': metric, 'cases': rows['parent']['cases'],
                       'values': values, 'percent_vs_parent': deltas})
print('\nMETHOD ORDER:', ', '.join(methods))
(root / 'human-metric-comparison-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')

"""Bind report tables to fixed final scores, without inference or endpoint selection."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3')
scores = json.loads((root / 'scores-v1.json').read_text())
methods = ['parent'] + [f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000' for arm in ['legacy-control', 'fine-mesh'] for endpoint in ['raw', 'EMA']]
labels = dict(zip(methods, ['V143', 'Legacy ctrl raw', 'Legacy ctrl EMA', 'Fine mesh raw', 'Fine mesh EMA'], strict=True))
cells, lines = [], []
sections = {}

def group(kind, condition, cohort=None):
    return {s['method']: s for s in scores['summary']
            if (s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) == (kind, condition, cohort)}

def val(g, method, field, digits=6):
    item = g[method]
    text = f'{item[field]:.{digits}f}'
    cells.append({k: item[k] for k in ['kind', 'condition', 'cohort', 'method']} |
                 {'field': field, 'digits': digits, 'rendered': text})
    return text

def row(title, g, field, digits=6):
    line = '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field, digits) for method in methods) + '|'
    lines.append(line)
    return line + '\n'

def header(title):
    return '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(labels[m] for m in methods) + '|\n| --- |' + ' ---: |' * len(methods) + '\n'

text = '| Method | Present full RMS | Response | Actual blank RMS | Blank spatial RMS | Added blank RMS |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for method in methods + ['periodic-detail']:
    line = '|' + labels.get(method, 'Existing periodic detail') + '|' + '|'.join(
        val(group('mesh', True), method, field, digits) for field, digits in [
            ('full_error_RMS_DN16', 6), ('template_gain', 8), ('blank_error_RMS_DN16', 6),
            ('blank_spatial_RMS_DN16', 6), ('blank_added_RMS_DN16', 8)]) + '|'
    lines.append(line)
    text += line + '\n'
sections['mesh'] = text
text = header('Flat test')
for title, g in [('Native512 ISO6400', group('flat', 'iso6400-prior', 'fresh-flat512')),
                 ('Native512 ISO12800', group('flat', 'iso12800-prior', 'fresh-flat512')),
                 ('Older native256 ISO12800', group('flat', 'iso12800-prior'))]:
    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' spatial RMS', 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), (' block32 RMS', 'block32_RMS_DN16')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, g, field)
sections['flat'] = text
text = header('Photo test')
for title, condition, cohort in [('Retained512 faint', 'photo-faint', 'retained512'), ('Retained512 dark', 'photo-dark', 'retained512'), ('Organic384 faint', 'photo-faint', 'organic384'), ('Organic384 dark', 'photo-dark', 'organic384')]:
    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' band error', 'crop_relative_band_error'), (' band response', 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, group('photo', condition, cohort), field)
sections['photo'] = text
text = '| Prior | Method | Whole RMS | Quiet RMS | Quiet spatial RMS |\n| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for condition, title in [('iso6400-prior', 'ISO6400'), ('iso12800-prior', 'ISO12800')]:
    g = group('mixed-quiet', condition)
    for method in methods:
        line = '|' + title + '|' + labels[method] + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field) for field in ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16']) + '|'
        lines.append(line)
        text += line + '\n'
sections['quiet'] = text
text = header('ADC test')
adc, slopes = group('photo', 'adc-only', 'adc-photo256'), group('flat', 'adc-only', 'adc-sloped512')
for title, g, field in [('Photo full RMS', adc, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Photo band error', adc, 'crop_relative_band_error'), ('Photo band response', adc, 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'), ('Sloped512 full RMS', slopes, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 spatial RMS', slopes, 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 block32 RMS', slopes, 'block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 crop block32 RMS', slopes, 'crop_block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 worst absolute DC', slopes, 'worst_abs_DC_DN16')]:
    text += row(title, g, field)
sections['ADC'] = text
assert len(cells) == 205
(root / 'report-table-bindings-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cells': cells, 'lines': lines, 'sections': sections}, indent=2) + '\n')

    print(title + '\n' + text)

def ref(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()

def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write("\n")


def rng():
    return {"python": hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(random.getstate())).hexdigest(), "numpy": hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(np.random.get_state())).hexdigest(), "torch_CPU": hashlib.sha256(torch.get_rng_state().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(), "torch_CUDA": hashlib.sha256(torch.cuda.get_rng_state().cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()}


def errors(value, target, roi):
    x, y, w, h = roi
    full = value.astype(np.float64)-target.astype(np.float64)
    crop = full[..., y:y+h, x:x+w]
    dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
    return {"full_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(full**2))*65535), "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((crop-dc)**2))*65535), "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2))*65535)}


def main():
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False

    out = ROOT / "transfer-v1"

    photo_path = ROOT.parent / "V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("photo_metrics", photo_path)
    photo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(photo)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[-1:1:512j, -1:1:512j]
    q = np.linalg.qr(np.stack([np.ones_like(xx), xx, yy], -1).reshape(-1, 3), mode="reduced")[0]

    def detrend(value):
        v = value.reshape(3, -1).T
        return v - q @ (q.T @ v)

    torch.cuda.init()
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(min(.9, 12*2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory))
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()

        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 32*2**30
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        assert ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))

        delta, diagnostic = collaborative_detail(torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["packed"]).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["variance"]).cuda(), torch.from_numpy(arrays["colors"]).cuda(), neighbors=policy["neighbors"], alpha=policy["alpha"])
        correction = delta.cpu().numpy()
        corrected = parent + correction
        changed = not np.array_equal(parent, corrected)
        binding = case["parent"]
        if changed:
            path = out / "predictions" / f"{index:03d}.npy"

        values = {"parent": (parent, case["parent"]), "collaborative": (corrected, binding)}

            values["periodic-detail"] = (np.load(case["periodic_detail"]["path"]), case["periodic_detail"])
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            empty = arrays["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
            signal = detrend(arrays["target_present"][0].astype(np.float64)-empty)
            energy = np.sum(signal**2)
            blank = np.all(arrays["target_present"] == arrays["target_empty"], axis=1)[0] if case["present"] else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
        actual_rows = []
        for label, (value, prediction) in values.items():
            row = {"id": case["id"], "index": index, "kind": case["kind"], "method": label, "prediction": prediction, "changed": not np.array_equal(value, parent)}
            if label == "collaborative":
                row["diagnostic"] = diagnostic
                row["correction_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(correction.astype(np.float64)**2))*65535)
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                row.update(present=case["present"], seed=case["seed"], **errors(value, arrays["target"], [176, 176, 160, 160]))
                difference = value[0].astype(np.float64)-parent[0].astype(np.float64)
                row["template_gain"] = float(np.sum(detrend(value[0].astype(np.float64)-empty)*signal)/energy)
                row["blank_pixels"] = int(blank.sum())
                row["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(difference[:, blank]**2))*65535) if blank.any() else None
                if label == "periodic-detail":
                    assert abs(row["full_error_RMS_DN16"]-case["periodic_expected_full_RMS"]) < 1e-10
            elif case["kind"] == "photo":
                row.update(cohort=case["cohort"], variant=case["variant"]["name"], **photo.photo_metrics(value, arrays["target"], arrays, case["ROI_xywh"]))
            elif case["kind"] == "flat":

            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "real"
                row["reference_scored"] = False
            rows.append(row)

        save(out / "rows" / f"{index:03d}.json", {"case_index": index, "rows": actual_rows})
        for key in ("arrays", "parent"):

            print(json.dumps({"finished": index+1, "elapsed_seconds": time.time()-started, "changed": sum(r["changed"] for r in rows if r["method"] == "collaborative")}), flush=True)
        del delta, correction, corrected, parent, arrays, values
    after = rng()
    assert before == after

    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:

    result = {"status": "complete-unchanged-policy-cached-transfer", "plan": ref(plan_path), "operator": ref(__file__), "module": policy["module"], "photo_metric_operator": ref(photo_path), "created_unix_UTC": started, "finished_unix_UTC": time.time(), "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}, "rows": rows, "summary": summary, "RNG_before": before, "RNG_after": after, "RNG_unchanged": True, "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(), "new_model_forwards": 0, "new_DINO_forwards": 0, "new_noise_draws": 0, "training_updates": 0, "RAW_decodes": 0, "scope": plan["scope"]}

def linear(v, arrays):
    return np.einsum("bij,bjhw->bihw", arrays["matrix"].astype(np.float64), v.astype(np.float64)*arrays["wb"].astype(np.float64)[..., None, None])


def band(v, arrays):
    basis = np.cos(np.pi*(np.arange(16)[None]+.5)*np.arange(16)[:, None]/16)*np.sqrt(2/16)
    basis[0] /= np.sqrt(2)
    luma = np.einsum("c,bchw->bhw", np.array([.2126, .7152, .0722]), linear(v, arrays))
    blocks = luma.reshape(1, 10, 16, 10, 16).transpose(0, 1, 3, 2, 4).reshape(1, 100, 16, 16)
    frequency = np.arange(16)/32
    r = np.hypot(frequency[:, None], frequency[None])
    return (basis @ blocks @ basis.T)[..., (r >= 1/8) & (r < 1/3)]


def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    result = errors(value, target, roi)
    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y:y+h, x:x+w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    result["crop_error_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((a-b)**2))*65535)
    p, t = band(a, arrays), band(b, arrays)
    energy = float(np.sum(t*t))
    gain = float(np.sum(p*t)/energy)
    result.update(crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain=gain, crop_relative_band_error=float(np.sqrt(np.sum((p-t)**2)/energy)), crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.sum((p-gain*t)**2)/25600)*65535))

    # Closed affine moments on the symmetric regular grid, independent of QR.

def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import band

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import linear_rgb

    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y : y + h, x : x + w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    error = a - b
    dc = error.mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
    predicted, _ = band(linear_rgb(a, arrays))
    truth, _ = band(linear_rgb(b, arrays))
    energy = float(np.sum(truth * truth))
    if energy <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Photo diagnostic needs nonzero target detail")
    gain = float(np.sum(predicted * truth) / energy)
    return {
        "full_error_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.mean((value.astype(np.float64) - target) ** 2)) * 65535
        ),
        "crop_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain": gain,
        "crop_relative_band_error": float(np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - truth) ** 2) / energy)),
        "crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - gain * truth) ** 2) / (100 * 256)) * 65535
        ),
    }

def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second

def fit(plan, phase):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    import yaml

        assert all(m.relative_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0 for m in modules.values())
        assert modules["fine-mesh"].harmonic_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0
        for label, m in modules.items():
            assert (
                sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameters"]
                and len(m.state_dict()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameter_tensors"]
            )
            m.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, label=label: counts.__setitem__(label, counts[label] + 1)
            )
        opts = {k: torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(), lr=config["lr"]) for k, m in modules.items()}
        emas = {
            k: {n: v.detach().clone() for n, v in m.state_dict().items()}
            for k, m in modules.items()
        }
        return modules, opts, emas

    modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
    maximum = {k: {n: 0.0 for n, _ in m.named_parameters()} for k, m in modules.items()}
    cache_rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]

    checkpointdir = root / "checkpoints"

    trace = []
    last = 0
    journal = (root / f"{phase}-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step,tag=None):
        dest = checkpointdir / f"{tag or phase}-step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not dest.exists()
        with dest.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "horizon": 1000,
                    "module_config": {"max_window": 256},
                    "module_configs": module_configs,
                    "arms": recipe["arms"],
                    "models": {k: m.state_dict() for k, m in modules.items()},
                    "emas": emas,
                    "optimizers": {k: o.state_dict() for k, o in optimizers.items()},
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "updates": dict(updates),
                    "parent": plan["parent"],
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "config": config,
                    "torch_CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "torch_CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                },
                stream,
            )
        return dest

    assert phase == "train"
    resume_info = read(root/"resume-adoption-v1.json")
    original_trace = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(resume_info["original_training_journal"]["path"]).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(original_trace) == 915 and ref(resume_info["checkpoint"]["path"]) == resume_info["checkpoint"]
    restored = torch.load(resume_info["checkpoint"]["path"],map_location="cpu",weights_only=True)
    assert restored["step"] == 750 and restored["counts"] == restored["updates"] == {k:750 for k in modules}
    def cpu_tree(value):
        if isinstance(value,torch.Tensor):return value.detach().cpu()
        if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:cpu_tree(v) for k,v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value,list):return [cpu_tree(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value,tuple):return tuple(cpu_tree(v) for v in value)
        return value
    for label,module in modules.items():
        module.load_state_dict(restored["models"][label],strict=True)
        optimizers[label].load_state_dict(restored["optimizers"][label])
        emas[label] = {n:v.cuda() for n,v in restored["emas"][label].items()}
        assert equal_tree(cpu_tree(module.state_dict()),restored["models"][label])
        assert equal_tree(cpu_tree(optimizers[label].state_dict()),restored["optimizers"][label])
        assert equal_tree(cpu_tree(emas[label]),restored["emas"][label])
    counts.update(restored["counts"]);updates.update(restored["updates"])
    prefix_ADC = sum(ADC_only(item["metadata"]["noise"]) for item in cache_rows[:750])
    for label in modules:

    compatible_steps = 750

        before = reference_trace[oldrow["step"]-1]["arms"]["bounded-support"]
        assert {k:oldrow["arms"]["legacy-control"][k] for k in before} == before
    maximum = {k:dict(v) for k,v in read(root/"smoke-result-v1.json")["parameter_maximum_gradients"].items()}
    trace = original_trace[:750]
    for oldrow in trace:journal.write(json.dumps(oldrow,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    journal.flush();last=750
    LIVE_PROGRESS.update(last_completed_step=750,adopted_prefix_steps=750)
    torch.set_rng_state(restored["torch_CPU_RNG"]);torch.cuda.set_rng_state(restored["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
    del restored
    actual_forwards={label:0 for label in modules};active_step={"value":750};overlap_exact=0
    forward_journal=(root/"resume-forward-events-v1.jsonl").open("x")
    def observe(label):
        actual_forwards[label]+=1
        forward_journal.write(json.dumps({"step":active_step["value"],"arm":label,"actual_returned_forwards":dict(actual_forwards),"images":4})+"\n")
        forward_journal.flush()
    for label,module in modules.items():module.register_forward_hook(lambda *args,label=label:observe(label))
    save(root/"resume-restoration-v1.json",{"status":"exact750-model-EMA-Adam-and-RNG-restoration-before-new-forward", "checkpoint":resume_info["checkpoint"],
        "adopted_trace_rows":750,"prefix_ADC_batches":prefix_ADC,"finite_Adam_states":94,"new_forwards":0})
    for step in range(751,1001):
        active_step["value"]=step
        try:resource_check(root)
        except AssertionError:
            pause_path=checkpoint(last,tag="resource-guard")
            save(root/"resource-pause-v1.json",{"status":"durably-checkpointed-waiting-for-headroom","step":last,"checkpoint":ref(pause_path)})
            while True:
                try:resource_check(root);break
                except AssertionError:time.sleep(5)
            save(root/"resource-pause-return-v1.json",{"status":"headroom-restored-no-repeated-update","step":last,"checkpoint":ref(pause_path)})
        item = cache_rows[step - 1]
        assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        assert ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
        base = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
        assert fingerprint(base) == item["parent_values"]
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
        batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in a.items()}
        base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "arms": {},
        }
        mask = flat_target_mask(
            batch["target"],
            window=recipe["flat_anchor_window"],
            tolerance_DN16=recipe["flat_anchor_tolerance_DN16"],
        )
        mask_cpu = mask.cpu().numpy()
        row["flat_target_mask"] = {
            "values": fingerprint(mask_cpu),
            "eligible_pixels": int(mask_cpu.sum()),
            "total_pixels": mask_cpu.size,
            "per_image_eligible_pixels": [int(v.sum()) for v in mask_cpu],
        }
        progress = max(0, step - config["warmup"]) / max(1, 1000 - config["warmup"])
        lr = (
            config["lr"]
            * min(1, step / config["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        for label, module in modules.items():
            if label == "fine-mesh":
                del batch,base,a,mask,mask_cpu
                item = candidate_rows[step-1]
                assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"] and ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
                a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
                assert {k:fingerprint(v) for k,v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
                base = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
                assert fingerprint(base) == item["parent_values"]
                batch = {k:torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k,v in a.items()}
                base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
                mask = flat_target_mask(batch["target"],window=recipe["flat_anchor_window"],tolerance_DN16=recipe["flat_anchor_tolerance_DN16"])
                mask_cpu = mask.cpu().numpy()
                row["candidate_batch"] = item["arrays"]
                row["candidate_parent"] = item["parent"]
                row["candidate_flat_target_mask"] = {"values":fingerprint(mask_cpu),"eligible_pixels":int(mask_cpu.sum()),
                    "total_pixels":mask_cpu.size,"per_image_eligible_pixels":[int(v.sum()) for v in mask_cpu]}
            optimizer = optimizers[label]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")), return_aux=True
            )
            minimum, maximum_support = float(aux["support"].detach().min()), float(aux["support"].detach().max())
            assert recipe["arms"][label]["support_floor"] <= minimum <= maximum_support <= 1
            if step == 1:
                assert torch.all(aux["support"] == .5)
                assert torch.equal(output, base) and aux["correction"].count_nonzero() == 0
            scale = (
                batch["variance"]
                .clamp_min(0)
                .mean((1, 2, 3), keepdim=True)
                .sqrt()
                .clamp_min(recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"] / 65535)
            )
            error = (output - batch["target"]) / scale
            pixel = (error.square() + config["pixel_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
            derivatives = [error[..., 1:] - error[..., :-1], error[..., 1:, :] - error[..., :-1, :]]
            gradient = (
                sum(
                    (v.square() + config["gradient_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
                    for v in derivatives
                )
                / 2
            )
            arm = recipe["arms"][label]
            is_ADC = ADC_only(item["metadata"]["noise"])
            peak_bonus = arm["spectral_peak_bonus"] if not is_ADC else 0
            assert peak_bonus == 0
            spectral = spectral_loss(
                module,
                output,
                batch["target"],
                batch["colors"],
                aux,
                arm["loss_floor_DN16"],
                arm["penalty"],
                arm["spectral_epsilon"],
            )
            peak_evaluations[label] += int(peak_bonus > 0)
            loss = config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * (
                pixel + config["gradient_weight"] * gradient + config["spectral_weight"] * spectral
            )
            local_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["local_risk_weight"]:
                local_penalty = local_excess_risk(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["local_risk_window_native"],
                    transition=recipe["local_risk_transition_noise_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["local_risk_weight"]
                    * local_penalty
                )
            dc_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["regional_DC_weight"]:
                dc_penalty = regional_dc_excess(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["regional_DC_window_native"],
                    transition=arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["regional_DC_weight"]
                    * dc_penalty
                )
            pair_scale = batch["pair_units"]
            if arm["pair_unit_floor_DN16"] == 2:
                entry = (unit_rows if label == "legacy-control" else candidate_units)[step - 1]
                assert entry["step"] == step and entry["batch"] == item["arrays"]
                pair_scale = pair_scale.new_tensor(entry["candidate_units_FP32"]).reshape(
                    entry["shape"]
                )
            pair_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["paired_response_weight"] and len(batch["pair_indices"]):
                pair_penalty = paired_response_loss(
                    output,
                    batch["target"],
                    pair_scale,
                    batch["pair_indices"],
                    epsilon=recipe["pair_epsilon"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["paired_response_weight"]
                    * pair_penalty
                )
            anchor_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["flat_anchor_weight"]:
                anchor_penalty = flat_target_anchor_loss(
                    output, batch["target"], mask, unit_DN16=recipe["flat_anchor_unit_DN16"]
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["flat_anchor_weight"]
                    * anchor_penalty
                )
            common_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            common_output = output
            if arm["pair_common_weight"] and len(batch["pair_indices"]):
                if arm["common_detach_support"]:
                    common_output = common_output_with_fixed_support(module, output, aux, batch["colors"], batch["wb"])
                    assert torch.equal(common_output.detach().view(torch.int32), output.detach().view(torch.int32))
                common_penalty = paired_common_error_loss(
                    common_output, batch["target"], batch["pair_indices"],
                    unit_DN16=recipe["pair_common_unit_DN16"],
                )
                loss = loss + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * arm["pair_common_weight"] * common_penalty
            loss = apply_ADC_weight(loss, item["metadata"]["noise"], arm["ADC_loss_weight"])
            has_supervision = not (is_ADC and arm["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0)
            supervised[label] += int(has_supervision)
            zero_ADC[label] += int(not has_supervision)
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            for name, p in module.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                maximum[label][name] = max(maximum[label][name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                if not has_supervision:
                    assert p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0

                assert loss == 0

            optimizer.step()
            updates[label] += 1
            decay = min(config["EMA_decay"], (1 + step) / (10 + step))
            with torch.no_grad():

            row["arms"][label] = {
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "pixel": float(pixel.detach()),
                "gradient": float(gradient.detach()),
                "spectral": float(spectral.detach()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "lr": lr,
                "local_excess_risk": float(local_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_excess": float(dc_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_transition_units": arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                "paired_response": float(pair_penalty.detach()),
                "pair_common_error": float(common_penalty.detach()),
                "common_support_detached": bool(arm["common_detach_support"] and len(batch["pair_indices"])),
                "support_mean": float(aux["support"].detach().mean()),
                "support_minimum": minimum,
                "support_maximum": maximum_support,
                "declared_support_floor": arm["support_floor"],
                "spectral_delta_RMS": float(aux["spectral_delta"].detach().abs().square().mean().sqrt()),
                "pair_unit_values": fingerprint(pair_scale.detach().cpu().numpy()),
                "pair_unit_floor_DN16": arm["pair_unit_floor_DN16"],
                "flat_target_anchor": float(anchor_penalty.detach()),
                "coupled_pairs": len(batch["pair_indices"]),
                **(
                    {
                        "spatial_correction_RMS_DN16": float(
                            aux["spatial_correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt()
                        )
                        * 65535
                    }
                    if "spatial_correction" in aux
                    else {}
                ),
            }
            if label == "legacy-control":
                expected = reference_trace[step - 1]["arms"]["bounded-support"]
                assert {k: row["arms"][label][k] for k in expected} == expected, (
                    phase,
                    step,
                    "V167 bounded control trace",
                )
                compatible_steps += 1
            del (
                output,
                aux,
                error,
                pixel,
                derivatives,
                gradient,
                spectral,
                local_penalty,
                dc_penalty,
                loss,
                scale,
                pair_penalty,
                common_penalty,
                common_output,
                pair_scale,
                anchor_penalty,
            )

        if step <= 915:
            assert row == original_trace[step-1], (step,"completed-overlap-trace-drift")

def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second
